environment.scope: Default study package environment only. Per-configuration declared_environment and toolchain commands override native-toolkit defaults; verify per-run snapshots before release comparisons.

implementation_ontology.actual_algorithm: Ten native exhaustive descriptor-matching optimizations, from scalar thread/query through padded shared tiling, four-component loads, register blocking and streamed prefetch.
implementation_ontology.work_item_mapping: Each source variant retains its work geometry, shared capacity, dataflow, FMA order, and native tie reduction. Four-scalar component accesses replace float4 syntax.

reference_repair.finding: Historical CUDA.jl uses GEMM plus row argmax for every MatchGPU1..10 label rather than the ten native optimization mappings. This may compute the same positive unique-maximum operator but does not preserve variant geometry, tiling, shared layout or reduction. Its supposed CPU reference is its own GPU output. Study restores ten actual kernels and independent integer-dot witnesses; no wrong scientific operator is inferred merely from the historical mapping substitution.

snapshot_provenance.transformation: Only guards NPTS macro for named128-point fixture; all ten native kernel bodies byte-identical.

reference_repair.tie_semantics: Native1..5 earliest global positive maximum. Native6 groups four candidates within16tiles; native7..10 groups within32tiles. Group priority precedes tile priority, so equal-score indices may legitimately differ across variants.

host_oracle_precision: Julia Int64 exact numerator dot product
implementation_ontology.artifact_encoding: Float64 numeric encoding of Float32 scores and Int32 indices, no FP64 GPU arithmetic
